description: Documentation detailing the Buy Down Fee feature in Apache Fineract, including its purpose, configuration, validation rules, transaction types, API endpoints, database structure, accounting entries, business events, and notes on behavior and validation.

classes.name: m_product_loan
classes.description: Database table storing loan product configurations related to buy down fee features.

classes.name: m_loan_transaction
classes.description: Database table storing various loan transactions, including buy down fee and amortization transactions.

classes.name: m_loan_buy_down_fee_balance
classes.description: Database table tracking buy down fee balances, adjustments, and amortizations per loan transaction.

methods.name: Configure Buy Down Fee on Loan Product
methods.description: API to enable and configure buy down fee parameters on a loan product.

methods.name: Add Buy Down Fee
methods.description: API to create a buy down fee transaction for a loan.

methods.name: Get Buy Down Fee Amortization Info
methods.description: API to retrieve amortization details for a specific buy down fee.

methods.name: Add Buy Down Fee Adjustment
methods.description: API to adjust (reduce) an existing buy down fee transaction.

methods.name: Buy Down Fee Template API
methods.description: API to retrieve limits and options for buy down fee transactions.

methods.name: Buy Down Fee Adjustment Template API
methods.description: API to retrieve limits and options for buy down fee adjustments.
